notes: The sheet considers an algebraic extension k′/k, the induced functors on motives, and maps between the displayed group objects. It asserts that G′ → G is a mono inducing an isomorphism on the connected components, then displays U′ ≃ U and G′⁰ ≃ G⁰. Those assertions are transcribed, without a proof check. The first chi in the concluding display carries no prime, although the corresponding square above uses chi′; the ink is retained. The lower-left label remains doubtful under its cancellation. Archive number 138 is written sideways at the original lower-left. H's appended heading and coverage note concern another sheet and supply no source text for this scan.

hand: The long-descending looped g recurs consistently beside compact G. The alphabet mapping is recorded in the notation table, without treating H’s font choice alone as a substantive difference.
